objective_contribution: Prevent a zero-model-token stateless tokenizer transient from discarding an already costly GLM trajectory, so the unchanged 8K shared-prefix state hypothesis can complete within cumulative model input plus output tokens.

question_and_hypotheses.question: Does a common identical-body two-attempt policy across both stateless tokenizer paths eliminate single zero-response censoring without changing model tokens or semantics?

measurement_mapping.native: Only valid paired native scores estimate ContextBench evidence-selection usefulness; tokenizer recovery proves no semantic benefit.
measurement_mapping.retention: Confirmed delivery, displacement, exact state presentation and independently scored later evidence use remain required.
measurement_mapping.integrity: Verify tokenizer path, eligibility, identical bytes, physical attempt receipts, logical budgets, shared-prefix ancestry, exposure and effects.
measurement_mapping.tokens: Tokenizer attempts add zero model tokens; still count every model input and output token in prefixes, failures, corrections and terminal requests under 96,000.
measurement_mapping.transfer: Shared tokenizer recovery is reusable infrastructure, but one exposed GLM-5.3-flash 8K round cannot establish larger-window, model, domain, correctness or confirmation transfer.

acceptance_and_scope.window_order: Finish the GLM small-window chapter before larger windows, other models, or domains.
acceptance_and_scope.exposure: Same exposed eight-task cohort. Round 17 is immutable historical evidence. Reserved confirmation remains untouched.
acceptance_and_scope.stopping_rules: No tuning, replacement, source refresh, prompt/cap/threshold/state/scorer change or favorable rerun. Only request-tokenizer retry parity may change.

retained_counterevidence: Round 17 stopped after ten of 56 cells, leaving 46 unstarted.
Task 1 mean span delta was +0.2028, but one of three repetitions favored control.
Task 2 state ended invalid_final_response due invalid source provenance.
Task 2 control then hit one request-tokenizer request-failed event with zero response bytes.
The failed control had 13,499 known cumulative model tokens and zero unknown model usage.
H27 recovery is supported, while H25 remains decision-ineligible and transfer/correctness/clearance remain unproved.
successor_rule: Prove cross-path retry parity with zero model dispatch, then freeze and run every new cell once. Review H29 separately from H25. If two attempts still fail, select H28 failure isolation without hiding or rerunning missing outcomes. Every successor passes policy v4 exact-value continuity.
